decisions.reason: The multi-model formwork profile line had its own page and sits at the core of the formwork offer, so management will keep defending this visible investment even though it was not observed online in 2020-2021.

The automated concrete distributor flow control embodies the announced automation strategy and in-house R&D, so weak visibility can be read as temporary and dropping it would contradict the firm's stated direction.
The shuttering magnet line is a cheap extension of the established magnetic formwork range, and keeping it costs little while preserving the completeness of the system offer.
The magnetic formwork strips are a multi-model line with a dedicated page and core relevance, which creates public commitment the firm will want to justify.
This component had its own web presence and fits the integrated formwork system, so withdrawing it would undercut earlier decisions despite its lower visibility since then.
The lowest-commitment item overlaps with other magnetic parts, but it complements the system offer at low cost, so the firm is likely to keep it rather than admit a misstep.
